purpose: Defines high-value trait pairings where one trait visibly affects another in animation.

rules.name: TV Broadcast Loop
rules.behavior: antenna pings travel into the CRT screen; high gas turns clean waves into glitch forks
rules.milestoneVariant: gold broadcast burst paints a one-frame message on the CRT

rules.name: Clockwork Collar Drive
rules.behavior: collar teeth drive the clock hands; when gas rises, both collar and hands accelerate together
rules.milestoneVariant: gold collar halo makes clock numerals glow

rules.name: Diver Fluid Circuit
rules.behavior: blue bubbles travel from jacket tubes into helmet portholes; high gas boils the shared circuit
rules.milestoneVariant: cosmic fluid fills the porthole rim

rules.name: Radio Speaker Body
rules.behavior: radio grille emits visible sound rings that continue through the chest speaker
rules.milestoneVariant: royal broadcast ring crosses head and chest together

rules.name: Reservoir Head Loop
rules.behavior: fluid level in head and backpack sway in linked phase; pressure makes both boil
rules.milestoneVariant: aurora reservoir shimmer appears in both tanks

rules.name: Pressure Hose Redline
rules.behavior: pressure ripple travels through hose and moves gauge needle; high gas redlines the face
rules.milestoneVariant: mythic redline seal locks around the gauge

rules.name: Market Jackpot Chain
rules.behavior: slot jackpot flash runs through each chain link after a verified sale tier
rules.milestoneVariant: all links pulse black-gold on Royal Archive Seal or higher

rules.name: Typed Archive Tag
rules.behavior: typewriter prints transfer marks that appear as tiny stamps on the archive tag
rules.milestoneVariant: major sale engraves provenance tier onto tag

rules.name: Focus Tracker
rules.behavior: signal tracker needle pulls the camera lens into focus during calm gas
rules.milestoneVariant: provenance flash frame locks in perfect focus

rules.name: Cassette Speaker Wave
rules.behavior: cassette reel rhythm becomes a visible speaker chest wave
rules.milestoneVariant: gold tape line crosses into speaker ring

rules.name: Projector Piston Power
rules.behavior: steam piston pack drives film reels and projector lens pulse
rules.milestoneVariant: gold premiere beam flashes from engine to lens

rules.name: Terminal Transaction Printer
rules.behavior: archive gauge pack sends pressure pulses that type terminal glyphs
rules.milestoneVariant: museum-grade seal prints on boot screen

rules.name: Handheld Canister Sync
rules.behavior: battery pulse stabilizes the handheld screen and reduces low-battery glitch
rules.milestoneVariant: gold START pulse appears on screen

rules.name: Gas Canister Valve
rules.behavior: valve rotation controls chimney smoke bursts
rules.milestoneVariant: gold steam spark moves through valve and chimney
